text:
izzy: Noticed a small but persistent host CPU drift on low-latency chat traffic after the http2 framing change. p95 up ~20%. Opening quick triage.
maria: Any perf crumbs? syscall heavy or tokenizer hotpath?
izzy: perf top shows a cluster in __writev + grpc_call_start_batch + tokenize_batch. snippet: `__writev` dominant, then grpc frame assemble, then tokenizer.
devin: Could be fragmentation: many tiny iovecs per RPC after header ribboning. writev syscall cost + iovec handling adds up for 10-30B user payloads.
cheng: Also seeing KV cache churn correlating with pre-tokenize flag: when ingress pretokenize is enabled we produce token-keyed cache entries; mixed key formats increase eviction rate.
sam: Kernel selector also misfires for singleton short requests. It leans on windowed avg_seq_len; single small requests get pulled into throughput kernel. We should prefer per-batch features.
izzy: Proposed quick plan (aim for small patchset):
  1) transport-level iov combiner: merge adjacent small iovecs into fewer iovs up to configurable limit (e.g., 3KB).
  2) ingress fastpath: skip pretokenize if seq_len < 40 (config flag).
  3) selector fastpath: if batch_size==1 and max_seq_len < 48, force low-latency kernel.
  4) kvcache key normalization: when pretokenize skipped, use stable raw-request hash key to avoid churn.
izzy: I prototyped (coalesce + skip) locally on short-chat trace (5k qps): baseline CPU=100, p50=20ms, p95=190ms; patch CPU=85, p50=21ms, p95=130ms.
maria: That looks good. p50 hit is tiny; tail win is substantial. Add metrics: `transport.iov_merged`, `ingress.pretokenize_skipped`, `selector.forced_lowlat`.
cheng: infra-bot, canary please on canary-hostpool-2?
infra-bot: Canary started at 1765554380. Routing short-chat 8k rps for 30m. Will report summary.
infra-bot: Canary summary (30m): host_cpu -14.1%, p50 +0.5ms, p95 -31%, kv_evictions/min -28%, transport.iov_merged=11.2k, ingress.pretokenize_skipped=9.8k.
devin: Good signal. Let's land small coordinated PRs: transport change, ingress flag, selector tweak, kv key fix. Keep toggles default-on in canary config and gated via runtime flags.
sam: I'll update dashboards and add an alert if `transport.iov_merged` drops unexpectedly or if large-request p50 regresses >5%. Also add nightly short-chat perf job.
maria: Tests: unit test for iov combiner correctness (preserve ordering and size limits), selector unit tests for singleton override, integration test for kvcache stability when pretokenize off.
izzy: I'll open PRs and tag owners: alex transport, raj kvcache, tao selector, sam perf. Aim to stage to Dedicated first.
cheng: sounds good. followups: link PRs here, 24h canary in eu-west, update changelog.
sam: thumbs-up.
